newsitem.title: INDIA: Japan Ricoh to raise stake in India firm.
newsitem.headline: Japan Ricoh to raise stake in India firm.

text.p: Japanese office equipment maker Ricoh Co Ltd said on Thursday it will pay about $200,000 to raise its stake in Gestetner India Limited to 51 percent from 49.5 percent within the next three months.

"We have a 49.5 percent share in Gestetner India and we have decided to increase it to 51 percent," Gestetner Holdings Plc chairman Naoto Shibata told a news conference in the eastern city of Calcutta.
Ricoh acquired Gestetner Holdings in July 1995.
Financial institutions and the public currently hold the remaining 51.5 percent of the firm's equity.
Gestetner India Ltd chief executive Paul Wilkinson said Ricoh would pump in some seven million rupees ($195,000) to raise its stake.
